walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the Cambridge IGCSE GCSE Business Studies specification.

Operations Management appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Operations Management in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Cambridge IGCSE board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Operations Management.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
